paragraphs: Serving the Fayetteville and Fort Bragg communities. Your trusted dentist in Fayetteville, NC, for families, military, and retirees.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort. We're the trusted go-to dentist in Fayetteville, NC, for compassionate care.

Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

As your trusted dentist in Fayetteville, NC, our experienced team of dental professionals is dedicated to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Fayetteville office! Right off Interstate 295, our Fayetteville location provides care for the Fayetteville community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Hope Mills, Spring Lake, Eastover, and more. With our highly advanced technology and an experienced team, we provide the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, pain-free smile!

Our modern, inviting space is filled with a professional, experienced team that strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenient access to the Westwood Shopping Center and the Bordeaux Shopping Center, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Fayetteville office stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Fayetteville office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Fayetteville location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and adults with pediatric or orthodontic care most comfortably and comprehensively as they deserve.
Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.
To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Fayetteville office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What emergency dental services are offered in Fayetteville, NC?

At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Fayetteville location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you accept pediatric or family dentistry patients in Fayetteville?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and adults with pediatric or orthodontic care most comfortably and comprehensively as they deserve.

Can I get cosmetic services like veneers or whitening in Fayetteville?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Do you place dental implants at the Fayetteville office?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available. 

How can I schedule my first appointment at Riccobene in Fayetteville?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Does the Fayetteville office accept dental insurance or offer payment plans?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
